t: You're looking at the Princess Grace Hospital, a private hospital in Marylebone. It's part of the international division of HCA, which is described as the world's largest private healthcare company. The name comes from Grace Kelly. She was an American actress who found stardom in Hollywood in the early to mid-1950s, won an Academy Award, and was ranked thirteenth on the American Film Institute's list of the greatest female stars. In 1956 she married Prince Rainier III and became Princess of Monaco, which she remained until her death in 1982.
